# Flat-row cache invalidation belongs to row mutations

Visible row lookups reuse TreeDataAdapter's flat cache until it is cleared or updated. The mutation paths added here clear it before notifying a tree or redrawing asynchronously loaded children; accepted open/close handling later updates cached descendants in place. appendRow itself still only pushes and returns the row, so calling it after a cached lookup requires another invalidation to avoid retaining the old flattened result. That is a conditional API boundary, with no active product failure or speedup established. Sparse slots and hierarchy metadata must remain part of the cache contract.

Scope: TreeDataAdapter cache ownership.
